t: This is number 36 Sackville Street, a house in Mayfair designed by Henry Flitcroft. Flitcroft is a good person to meet here. He came from a humble background, his father a labourer in the gardens at Hampton Court, and he began as a joiner. After he fell from a scaffold at Burlington House, Lord Burlington noticed his talent with a pencil, and he became Burlington's draughtsman and assistant. He went on to be a major architect of English Palladianism. The dentist James Parkinson later lived in the house.
